title: Make the Most of Your Trial
steps: [{"num":"1","heading":"Schedule Dedicated Time","body":"Block 2-3 hours on your calendar this week to explore the platform. Treat it like a real project deadline. Without dedicated time, the trial period slips away before you have properly evaluated the tools."},{"num":"2","heading":"Build Something Real","body":"Do not just click through templates. Import a real project - a course you need to build, a presentation you have been putting off. Using your own content reveals whether the tool fits your actual workflow."},{"num":"3","heading":"Join the Community","body":"The user community is one of the most valuable resources. Browse the forums, watch community-created tutorials, and see how others solve problems similar to yours."},{"num":"4","heading":"Test Collaboration Features","body":"If you work in a team, invite a colleague to review a project. Test the feedback workflow, version history, and sharing options. The tool is only as good as how well your team can use it together."}]
